scope: Finite WithToken startup-parameter isolation; not full profile qualification
constants: Same actual fresh-user restricted token,private desktop,environment,command,job-before-resume and32MiB cap
No LOGON_WITH_PROFILE,additional privileges,policy grant or API fallback
required_observations: Exact startup size/flags/attributes and actual Win32 error or process result for each variant
For launched children: actual user/restricting SID,nonelevated/nonadmin/non-AppContainer token and privilege observations
A deliberately inheritable excluded canary must not be available by exact volume/file identity in a candidate child
Candidate initial stdio is invalid; no inherited writable output outside owned scratch
